title: Esc menu
note: The suit menu over the running game (no pause), the left side panel the engineer approved on 2026-10-22 (pages/esc-start: «Yes, the menu on the left as on the page»), like a start menu: Esc (ui_cancel) brings one panel out at the left, full height, and the world stays visible at its right; no tabs and no footer row. The panel holds only what makes sense where the player is: in the ship with no session the own code and Find a lobby, Host, Tutorial, Guide, Settings, Quit; in the lobby the lobby's code and Resume, Character, Guide, Settings, Leave, Quit; in a round Resume, Guide, Settings, Leave, Quit (no Role: the HUD shows the role; no Character: it is changed only in the lobby); in the tutorial Resume, Guide, Settings, Leave the tutorial. An entry with a page opens it in a tile beside the panel. The game runs on; the mouse is free while the menu is open and captured again on close. While it is open the own character takes no gameplay input (it stands still: no move, look, sprint, jump, interact or item use; those keys go to the menu or nowhere); the voice keeps working as set (voice activation, or the Talk key while held). Focus: the frames show the mouse's view with no focus drawn; ship-keys shows the ring keyboard and gamepad focus draws. The host's match settings are the ship console's screen (s4). Open (each a visible placeholder here): the lobbies nearby and the own code need the game's network discovery (prime-game#1316); the Guide's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room); every MVP task's card art (the art track's; own-work Delivery frames stand in here).

states.label: Корабель
states.note: In the ship with no session, nothing open: the game boots straight here (the engineer, 2026-10-21) and every player returns here when a session ends or they leave it. The approved page's frame 1: the own code with Copy at the top, the entries, Quit apart at the bottom. No control is drawn focused: the frames show the mouse's view (ship-keys shows the focus ring).

states.label: Корабель: знайти лобі
states.note: Find a lobby open beside the panel (the approved page's frame 2): the lobbies nearby, the code entry with Join by address under it. The code field is empty, so its Join is disabled.

states.label: Корабель: поруч нікого
states.note: No lobby found on the network nearby: the list says so in one line, with no Join; the code entry as in ship-find.

states.label: Корабель: код
states.note: Six valid characters typed into the code field, so its Join is enabled.

states.label: З клавіатури
states.note: The same frame reached with the keyboard or a gamepad: the code's Join has the focus and draws its focus ring. The one frame that documents the ring; every other frame shows the mouse's view, with no focus drawn.

states.label: Корабель: за адресою
states.note: Join by address pressed: the address entry takes the code entry's place, with the default port under it; Join, or host directly.

states.label: Лобі
states.note: In the lobby (a session in the ship, no round yet), nothing open (the approved page's frame 3): the lobby's code with Copy at the top; Resume, Character, Guide, Settings; Leave and Quit apart at the bottom.

states.label: Персонаж
states.note: In the lobby, Character open: the name and the body colour apply live.

states.label: Раунд
states.note: In a round, nothing open: Resume, Guide, Settings; Leave and Quit at the bottom. No head, no Role (the HUD shows the role), no Character (changed only in the lobby).

states.label: Раунд: підтвердження
states.note: The host pressed Leave: the confirm dialog (P1) over the menu. Quit opens the same dialog titled esc.game.quit_confirm with Confirm esc.game.quit. A player leaves or quits at once.

states.label: Посібник
states.note: In a round, Guide open: every how-to card, the basics from the tutorial and one card per MVP task type; Cooking selected. Its art is a placeholder (own-work Delivery frames) until the art track's cards exist; the card holds as many frames as its task needs and scrolls sideways.

states.label: Звук і голос
states.note: In a round, Settings open (the approved page's frame 4), on Sound and voice; the same page opens from the panel in every place. Voice activation is selected, so the threshold row shows. The language is chosen only here, on Language.

states.label: Керування
states.note: Interact is capturing a key; Talk was rebound to M, so Talk and Map show Same key. The list scrolls.

states.label: Мова
states.note: The game language, chosen only here; it applies at once.

states.label: Навчання
states.note: The tutorial's menu: Resume, Guide, Settings, and Leave the tutorial at the bottom, back to the ship.

nodes.name: Menu
nodes.note: The suit menu over the running game (no pause, no dim: the world stays visible at the right), the approved side panel (the engineer, 2026-10-22, pages/esc-start). mouse_filter IGNORE on this Control, so a click on the world outside the panel and the page reaches nothing (agent: it does not close the menu; Esc and Resume do). While the confirm dialog is open set focus_behavior_recursive = FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_DISABLED here (Control, Godot 4.5+) and restore FOCUS_BEHAVIOR_INHERITED on close.

children.name: Side
children.note: The suit menu (the engineer, 2026-10-22: «Yes, the menu on the left as on the page», pages/esc-start): one panel at the left, full height less the HUD's 36 px margin on three sides, 520 px wide (the page's frame); the world stays visible at its right, with no dim. ToyPanelMenu as it is (agent): its rounded corners and edge on every side are why the panel stands 36 px off the screen's edges instead of square against them, so the pack needs no new variation. Only what makes sense where the player is: the head (the own or the lobby's code), the entries, and at the bottom, apart under a hairline, leaving and quitting.

children.name: Head
children.note: The head row over the entries, its hairline under it (ToySettingRow draws only its bottom line); its 18 px sides line the code up with the entries' text. In the ship with no session: «Твій код», the own code, to call friends into the ship (whether every ship listens with a code is the game's, prime-game#1316; while there is none the head hides). In the lobby: «Код», the lobby's code. Hidden in a round and the tutorial.

children.name: V
children.note: Two lines: the small-capitals head over the code and Copy, as the other heads stand over their content; the page's one line does not fit 520 px at large text.

children.name: Label
children.note: A small-capitals head (uppercase = true): find.your_code in the ship with no session, common.code in the lobby.

children.name: Value
children.note: The own code in the ship, the lobby's code in the lobby (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); «…» while the code service has not made it yet.

children.name: Copy
children.note: Copies the code to the clipboard; the button reads esc.lobby.copied for 2 s.

children.name: Entries
children.note: The panel's entries, ToyMenuItem rows (dim idle text, the open page the pressed row fill with light text). An entry with a page (Find a lobby, Character, Guide, Settings) is a toggle in one ButtonGroup: pressing it opens its page in the tile beside the panel, pressing it again or Esc closes the page (Esc with no page open closes the menu). An entry that acts (Resume, Host, Tutorial) is a plain button outside the group. Per place: the ship with no session, Find a lobby, Host, Tutorial, Guide, Settings; the lobby, Resume, Character, Guide, Settings; a round and the tutorial, Resume, Guide, Settings. Opening the menu opens no page and grabs no focus, so the mouse's view draws no ring: the first ui_up, ui_down or ui_focus_next grabs focus on the first entry (keyboard and gamepad then draw the ring, ship-keys); ui_right moves it into the open page.

children.name: Resume
children.note: Closes the menu (as Esc). In a session and the tutorial; not in the ship with no session, where nothing runs to resume.

children.name: Find
children.note: Opens Find a lobby beside the panel. The ship with no session only.

children.name: Host
children.note: Hosts a game with a code (WebRTC): the ship becomes the lobby (s4) and the menu closes; the menu, opened again, shows the lobby's entries; a failure shows s3 host-failed. The code is on the ship console (s4) and in the head.

children.name: Tutorial
children.note: Loads the tutorial's first lesson (s1); its end returns to the ship.

children.name: Character
children.note: The lobby only (the engineer, 2026-10-22): the character is changed before the round, so the entry is not in a round or the tutorial.

children.name: Guide
children.note: Always there.

children.name: Settings
children.note: Always there; opens on Sound and voice.

children.name: Gap
children.note: Pushes the leaving group to the bottom of the panel.

children.name: Rule
children.note: The hairline over the leaving group: an empty ToySettingRow, so the line is the one every hairline row draws.

children.name: Bottom
children.note: Leaving and quitting, apart at the bottom, the same quiet rows as the entries.

children.name: Leave
children.note: The host of a session: opens the confirm dialog (round-confirm), whose Confirm is the danger button. A player: leaves at once. In the tutorial: esc.game.leave_tutorial, back to the ship at once. Leaving returns the player to the ship (s5 ship).

children.name: Quit
children.note: The host of a session: opens the confirm dialog (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). A player, and in the ship with no session: quits at once. Not in the tutorial (leave it first).

children.name: Page
children.note: The open entry's page, in a tile beside the panel (the approved page's frames 2 and 4): 24 px right of the panel, top-aligned with it, 1120 px wide on every page (agent), so switching entries never moves its edges sideways; its height follows the page (Settings and Guide share one 828 px view). One page at a time; with no page open the tile is hidden and the world shows.

children.name: Find
children.note: Find a lobby (esc.tab.find), the page beside the panel as the approved page's frame 2: the lobbies nearby at the left, the code entry at the right with Join by address under it. There is no server browser yet: Host (the panel's entry) makes a game with a code, the code entry takes a code, Join by address joins or hosts directly (LAN, VPN). The jobs of the removed start screen (s2, #111; prime-game#1285).

children.name: Nearby
children.note: The lobbies nearby (the engineer, 2026-10-22: needed; the game's discovery is prime-game#1316), as the target's list (.lst): the head in small capitals, the rows, Join under them at the right. What "nearby" means (LAN discovery, public lobbies) is the game's; the list is the same either way. It refreshes while the tab is open; a lobby that goes away leaves its row.

children.name: Head
children.note: The tile head in small capitals (uppercase = true).

children.name: List
children.note: Rows 8 px apart; the first lobby found is chosen when the tab opens. A long list scrolls (a ScrollContainer at the page's height; three rows here).

children.name: Glorp
children.note: One row per lobby found nearby, built from the discovery's list (prime-game#1316): ToyPresetCard, a toggle in one ButtonGroup with the other rows; the chosen one draws ToyPresetCardSelected (the target's accent edge). Its content (no text of its own) is a row: the lobby's name, its players and the latency. A Button's minimum size does not follow its children: custom_minimum_size holds the row at 60 (the target's 40 x 1.5). Double click = Join.

children.name: Count
children.note: Players of the maximum (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED), as the target's «6 / 10».

children.name: Ping
children.note: The latency to the lobby's host, in whole ms.

children.name: Zinga
children.note: As the first row, not chosen.

children.name: Count
children.note: Players of the maximum (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED), as the target's «6 / 10».

children.name: Ping
children.note: The latency to the lobby's host, in whole ms.

children.name: Bulk
children.note: A full lobby: disabled (it cannot be chosen), its name dim and «Лобі заповнене.» in place of the players and the latency, as the target's muted row.

children.name: None
children.note: No lobby found nearby: one quiet line in the list's place, and no Join. It stays until a lobby appears.

children.name: Join
children.note: Joins the chosen lobby: s3 (the connecting steps). The target's filled Join under the list; the code entry's Join stays outlined. Disabled while no row is chosen.

children.name: Code
children.note: Join with a code: the target's code entry (.jn), a small-capitals head over the field, Join under it, then the quiet Join by address. 420 px holds «Приєднатися за адресою»'s column in ship-direct, so the column keeps one width.

children.name: Head
children.note: The tile head in small capitals: the game sets uppercase = true on this Label (the pack's uppercase member).

children.name: Field
children.note: Empty until typed (ship). max_length 6; upper-cases as typed, drops spaces and dashes on paste, accepts only the 31-letter code alphabet (no 0, O, 1, I, L). Keeps what was typed after a failure (back from s3). Enter = Join when it is enabled. auto_translate_mode DISABLED. A click focuses it (the caret shows); the menu does not grab focus for it on open.

children.name: Join
children.note: The target's outlined Join. Disabled (unplugged) until the field holds 6 valid characters. Joins by the code: s3 finding. ship-keys: reached with the keyboard, it draws the focus ring.

children.name: Direct
children.note: Join or host directly (LAN, VPN): opens the address entry in this column's place (ship-direct); Back or Esc (ui_cancel) closes it and the code entry comes back. A quiet ghost under the code's Join, as the approved side-panel page (pages/esc-start, frame 2).

children.name: Address
children.note: Join or host directly over ENet (LAN, VPN, playit.gg), in the code entry's place while Join by address is pressed. No address is shown anywhere else (streams).

children.name: Head
children.note: The tile head in small capitals (uppercase = true).

children.name: Field
children.note: Takes host or host:port, host names included (JoinTarget). Keeps what was typed after a failure. Enter = Join. auto_translate_mode DISABLED.

children.name: Port
children.note: The default port, used when the address has none.

children.name: Join
children.note: Disabled (unplugged) while Address is empty. Joins over ENet: s3 (the connecting steps, no code row).

children.name: Host
children.note: Hosts directly (ENet) on the port typed, else the default; the ship becomes the lobby (s4) with no code row.

children.name: Back
children.note: Closes the address entry (the code entry comes back, its Join by address focused when the keyboard opened it); Esc does the same.

children.name: Settings
children.note: One scene (#301), the target's settings page: the section list at the left, the section's hairline rows at the right. The mic, the mode, the threshold with its live meter, noise suppression and the volumes work without a session, in the ship, the lobby, a round and the tutorial. Saved per player.

children.name: Nav
children.note: The section list (the target's .nav): one ButtonGroup of toggle rows; the open section shows the pressed row fill. Settings opens on Sound and voice. Up and down move the focus through the list; ui_right moves it into the rows. 300 px holds «Звук і голос» and «Accessibility» at large text.

children.name: Sound
children.note: ToyMenuItem (the target's .nav item; a light-context variation since ui-2.2.0): dim idle text, the open section the pressed row fill with light text.

children.name: Scroll
children.note: follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the focused row in view (the 15 keys of Controls). The view is 700 x 828, so Sound and voice's nine rows fit without scrolling and the tile keeps one size on every section. Spectating left the MVP (the dead wait in the dead's room), so its two keys are gone from Controls.

children.name: Rows
children.note: Hairline rows (ToySettingRow: the label at the left, the control at the row's right, a 2 px line under each), as the target's .sr; the pack has no zero-gap column, so 4 px stand between the rows. Every row is at least 88 px tall (a dropdown row's height), so the rows of every section keep one height.

children.name: Ctl
children.note: The target's slider with its value at the right (.sld, .vv).

children.name: Slider
children.note: The Master bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), updated as the slider moves.

children.name: Ctl
children.note: The target's slider with its value at the right (.sld, .vv).

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), updated as the slider moves.

children.name: Ctl
children.note: The target's slider with its value at the right (.sld, .vv).

children.name: Slider
children.note: The effects bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), updated as the slider moves.

children.name: Ctl
children.note: The target's slider with its value at the right (.sld, .vv).

children.name: Slider
children.note: The music bus, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), updated as the slider moves.

children.name: Mode
children.note: Voice activation (with the threshold row), push to talk (the Talk key) or off: the target's dropdown, as wide as its text, at the row's right.

children.name: Threshold
children.note: Shown for voice activation only.

children.name: Ctl
children.note: The target's slider with its value at the right (.sld, .vv).

children.name: Slider
children.note: The voice-activation threshold, 0 to 100 %.

children.name: Value
children.note: str(value) (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), updated as the slider moves.

children.name: Mic
children.note: Without the voice add-on, Mic, TalkMode, Threshold and MicTest give way to one Label(ToyTextMutedOnLight) settings.voice_unavailable.

children.name: Device
children.note: Items: settings.mic.default, then the device names (not translated). A pick opens the device under the existing "opening" mark. A long device name is cut with an ellipsis, so the row keeps its 450 px.

children.name: Meter
children.note: The live mic level; it runs without a session (#301).

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup: RNNoise off or on.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Button(ToyKeyButton), wide (min 96): its text is the bound key's label, DisplayServer.keyboard_get_label_from_physical() of the action's binding (data, auto_translate_mode DISABLED); Space and the mouse buttons use key.space, key.mouse_left, key.mouse_right. A click or ui_accept starts capture.

children.name: Bind
children.note: Capturing: settings.controls.press_key on the pressed look; idle it shows the bound key's label (E). A click or ui_accept starts capture: set toggle_mode = true and set_pressed_no_signal(true), which draws ToyKeyButton's pressed StyleBox (it has no toggle partner), and restore both when capture ends. Capture runs in _input and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled() on every event, so nothing else sees it: the next key or mouse button binds, except the release of the click that started capture, which is ignored; Esc cancels and is consumed (the menu stays open); the arrows and ui_accept do not move or press focus while capturing.

children.name: Name
children.note: The item's own action on the right mouse button (the game's use_secondary, prime-game#1438), e.g. the mug's drink.

children.name: Same
children.note: Only on rows whose key clashes with another action of the same phase (here Map and Talk on M); give_up and ready share F legally (different phases, #211).

children.name: ResetGap
children.note: A spacer: 4 + 12 + 4 = 20 px between the last row and Reset.

children.name: Reset
children.note: Restores the default bindings. Esc itself is fixed.

children.name: Mode
children.note: One ButtonGroup: DisplayServer window mode.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup. On swaps GameUi's theme to game_theme_large.tres live.

children.name: Toggle
children.note: One ButtonGroup; the default comes from DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_animation(). On: the connecting spinner (s3) turns at half speed; the pre and post game fades (s6, s10) and the End fade are cuts; the button press is instant (the pressed StyleBox still shows).

children.name: Choice
children.note: One ButtonGroup; each language is named in itself (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); the language applies at once (#208). A long list later would take ToyRadio rows.

children.name: List
children.note: The view is 828 px tall, as Settings', so the tile keeps one size between Guide and Settings. follow_focus = true, so keyboard and gamepad focus scrolls the topic in view. 360 px holds the longest topic at large text.

children.name: V
children.note: One ButtonGroup over every topic, drawn as the settings' section list (the open topic shows the pressed row fill); a topic shows its card, headed with the topic's name. The MVP's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room) are open: their texts and cards are the engineer's.

children.name: Basics
children.note: A small-capitals head (uppercase = true).

children.name: Moving
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.move.title, .pick_up.title, .put_down.title, .hand_belt.title.

children.name: Voice
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.voice.title, tutorial.step.voice.how, tutorial.list.death.

children.name: Downed
children.note: Card frames: tutorial.step.downed.title, downed.give_up_hold, then the death frames: tutorial.step.dead_room.title, tutorial.step.dead_room.how (drafts; the dead wait in the dead's room, m8 §3).

children.name: Gap
children.note: A spacer: 4 + 16 + 4 = 24 px between the Downed row and the Tasks head.

children.name: Tasks
children.note: A small-capitals head (uppercase = true).

children.name: CarTuning
children.note: The MVP's five task types (GDD §8, #1144), in the deck's order. Each card needs new wordless art (the card art quality bar); until the art track's cards exist every card shows the placeholder (own-work Delivery frames, dist/pack/cards/).

children.name: Card
children.note: P8's how-to card without its own panel inside the page's tile (no tile in a tile): the head, then the frames in one row that scroll sideways, as in s3 and s8, with 272 px art beside the topic list. A card is content data per task type (#254).

children.name: Head
children.note: The card's head as in s3 and s8: howto.label in small capitals over the open topic's name, so the card is the same in s3, s5 and s8.

children.name: Note
children.note: The game sets uppercase = true.

children.name: Title
children.note: The open topic's name (a basics topic shows its guide.* name).

children.name: Scroll
children.note: The frames scroll sideways when they do not fit (the engineer, 2026-10-22): a card holds as many frames as its task needs. No bar is drawn (SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER) until the pack has a sideways bar; the frame cut at the card's edge shows there is more. The wheel scrolls it sideways while vertical scrolling is disabled, a drag on a touch screen too (unconfirmed for Godot 4.7.2: check ScrollContainer's wheel handling); follow_focus true. Here the view fills the card beside the topic list (at least one frame, 302 px; two frames and the edge of a third at the tile's width).

children.name: Art
children.note: PLACEHOLDER art: seven own-work Delivery frames (dist/pack/cards/delivery-meaning-1..3, delivery-1..3 and delivery-meaning-4, 640x480, transparent) stand in for the Cooking card's seven frames, which the engineer named every card's placeholder (2026-10-22). Those frames are generated art kept in the art track (prime-game-art#272) and this repo's licence list does not cover generated art yet, so the game takes them from the art track's pack. expand_mode IGNORE_272x204 here, 352x264 in s3 and s8, stretch_mode KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED; SIZE here; the same card in s3, s5 and s8. The cards are wordless: a frame holds only its art, no caption.

children.name: Frame7
children.note: The frame that shows the finish.

children.name: Preview
children.note: In the game: SubViewportContainer (stretch true) · min 456×608 with a SubViewport showing the own character; the page draws a ToyHowtoFrame placeholder.

children.name: Form
children.note: Changes apply live (the engineer, 2026-10-22: the character is changed only in the lobby, so the entry is not in the panel in a round or the tutorial). The Hat row (esc.character.hat) stays hidden until hats exist.

children.name: Field
children.note: The player's name, kept between sessions; auto_translate_mode DISABLED.

children.name: Swatches
children.note: The ten body colours (#255; the palette is not decided yet).

children.name: Swatch1
children.note: In the game: TextureButton · toggle_mode · one ButtonGroup · 60×60 · focus_mode ALL. The disc is tinted with the body colour (content data, #255; the page's colours are samples only). Keyboard and gamepad focus shows ToySwatchFocus, a Panel over the swatch (mouse_filter IGNORE), visible while it has focus; the frames show the mouse's view, so no swatch is drawn focused.

children.name: Disc
children.note: self_modulate = the body colour (content data).

children.name: Ring
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE.

children.name: Sel
children.note: mouse_filter IGNORE; visible while the swatch is selected.

nodes.name: ConfirmDim
nodes.note: mouse_filter STOP: blocks the mouse to the menu behind while the dialog is open. Keyboard and gamepad focus search ignores what is drawn on top, so Menu disables its focus while the dialog is open (its note). The dialog handles ui_cancel itself (= Cancel) and calls get_viewport().set_input_as_handled(), so Esc closes only the dialog, not the menu too.

nodes.name: Confirm
nodes.note: P1. Opened by the host's Leave (esc.game.leave_confirm, Confirm esc.game.leave) or Quit (esc.game.quit_confirm, Confirm esc.game.quit). ui_cancel = Cancel.

children.name: ConfirmButton
children.note: Ends the session for every player; everyone returns to their own ship (Quit: quits the game).

children.name: Cancel
children.note: Takes focus when the dialog was opened with the keyboard or a gamepad (it then draws the ring); opened with the mouse, nothing grabs focus. Closes the dialog.
